# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_TIGHTEN_22

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Tightening the VIX confirmation threshold for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON puts from VIX >= 20 to VIX >= 22 will filter out low-VIX loser trades where the setup tends to fail due to insufficient fear premium, while preserving high-VIX winner trades. This aims to increase edge_capture by reducing losses on J loser days without affecting J winner days.

## Mechanism

- **Entry trigger:** BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup fires (level rejection + EMA ribbon flip + confluence) as defined in playbook.
- **VIX filter:** Require VIX >= 22 at time of entry (previously VIX >= 20 or rising). VIX sourced from real-time quote via `mcp__cboe__get_vix`.
- **Exit logic:** Unchanged — chart-stop-primary (SPY closes 3-min candle above rejected level + $0.50 buffer), chandelier profit-lock arms at +5%, trails 0.15, premium stop catastrophe cap at -50% (Safe), time stop 15:50 ET.
- **State:** Filter applied in `gates.py` after `_derive_routing` but before entry approval, using same VIX quote as setup context filters.
